name: Shade Inoculation (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Path of the Twilight Veil

Benefit: The nightblade can make her allies immune to the effects of her distorting shadows. When she uses her distorting shadows ability, she can designate a number of creatures up to her Charisma modifier to be unaffected by the distorting shadows.
